known_issues.note: 4.4.x divides by zero in its throttle curve at thr_mid = 100 (only for the unused 110% point). SITL crashes; STM32 boards are expected to return 0 there and run normally (not tested on hardware).

downgrade:debug-mode-dshot-telemetry-cou.detail: PR #12709 added DSHOT_TELEMETRY_COUNTS at the end of the debug mode list. Every other debug mode name is the same in both versions.
downgrade:debug-mode-dshot-telemetry-cou.note: The DSHOT_TELEMETRY_COUNTS debug mode doesn't exist in 4.4.1, so the board's own default debug mode applies instead. Debug modes only change what gets recorded to Blackbox, not how the quad flies. If you need another one for logging, set it in the CLI, e.g. `set debug_mode = DSHOT_RPM_TELEMETRY`.

downgrade:gps-rescue-min-start-dist-clam.detail: PR #12835 changed the range from 20-1000 m to 10-30 m and made a rescue started inside this distance fly out past it. Before that change, the quad landed in place.
downgrade:gps-rescue-min-start-dist-clam.note: 4.4.1 allows 20-1000 m. Values of 10-19 m were raised to 20 m, and values from 20 to 30 m carry over unchanged. GPS Rescue also behaves differently in 4.4.1: if it starts closer to home than this distance, the quad lands in place instead of flying out first.

upgrade:gps-rescue-descent-dist-min-rais.detail: PR #12835 raised the CLI minimum for gps_rescue_descent_dist from 5 to 10 m and reworked the descent distance logic.
upgrade:gps-rescue-descent-dist-min-rais.note: The smallest allowed value is now 10 m. Values of 5-9 m were raised to 10 m. Values of 10 m and above carry over unchanged.

upgrade:gps-rescue-min-start-dist-behavi.detail: PR #12835 narrowed the range from 20-1000 m to 10-30 m and lowered the default from 30 to 15. A rescue started inside this distance now climbs and pitches forward until it is past it. Before, it landed in place.
upgrade:gps-rescue-min-start-dist-behavi.note: The allowed range is now 10-30 m. Values above 30 m were lowered to 30 m, and values from 20 to 30 m carry over unchanged. GPS Rescue also behaves differently now: if it starts closer to home than this distance, the quad climbs and flies out past it and then does a normal rescue. It no longer lands in place, so check that this suits where you fly.

set:gps_rescue_min_start_dist|downgrade|.comment: 4.4.1 minimum is 20 m, so 10-19 m becomes 20; a rescue inside this distance lands in place
